title: #245 Spending or Saving
prompt: When you earn money, is it better to enjoy it or save it for the future? Please prove your opinion with specific reasons.

promptSegments.text: When you earn money, is it better to enjoy it or save it for the future?
Please prove your opinion with specific reasons.
